bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating models' ability to predict the probability distribution of differing annotator judgments (soft labels) using cross-entropy, specifically capturing disagreements stemming from annotators' distinct demographics, identities, and political views (e.g., conservative vs. liberal, target demographic vs. control group).

Evaluating model predictions on sexism and misogyny detection tasks using the ArMIS (Arabic tweets) and ConvAbuse (conversational AI) datasets, assessing performance via soft-label evaluation to account for subjective annotator disagreements.

bias_targets.target: Religious and Nationality bias (Islamophobia and Xenophobia)
bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating models on hate speech detection using the HS-Brexit dataset, analyzing soft-label predictions on tweets relating to immigration and Brexit that were annotated by a target group of Muslim immigrants versus a control group.

bias_targets.target: Multiple intersecting biases (Racism, Homophobia, Transphobia, Ableism)
bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating abusiveness detection models on the ConvAbuse dataset, which features hierarchical labels for various specific types of targeted abuse, using soft evaluation metrics to measure how well models capture varying human interpretations.
